density.note: Settings → Appearance → Density (appSettings ui/density: compact | default | spacious). The scale multiplies Theme.gap(n) — the space BETWEEN things — on top of fontScale and spacingScale; the size of a thing (Theme.sp) never changes. Row geometry has its own per-density values in Spacing.

tokens.name: densityCompact
tokens.usage: Compact: gap(n) × densityCompact. Reduces rail, panel and card padding; rows tighten to the *Compact spacing tokens.

tokens.name: densityDefault
tokens.usage: Default (standard): gap(n) unchanged; rows at rowH, rowH2 … — exactly today's app.

tokens.name: densitySpacious
tokens.usage: Spacious: gap(n) × densitySpacious; rows open to the *Spacious spacing tokens.

tokens.name: overlayOpacity

tokens.name: variabilityPrintAlphaScale
tokens.usage: On paper (medium "print"), every translucent fill of the variability marks multiplies its alpha by this, clamped to 1, so the wash still prints: the Dispersion dots and group ellipse, the Needle's wedges, the typicality inner zone and ghost dots, the trace's envelope and the funnel's band. Strokes keep theirs (the Overlay traces, rings, lines, the band's edge). Used in place of roles.tintK, never with it.

tokens.name: variabilityWashAlpha
tokens.usage: On screen, every translucent wash of the variability marks multiplies its alpha by this, clamped to 1: the Dispersion Cell's group ellipse, the Needle's wedges (Icon and Cell, small-size alphas too), the funnel's band fill, the typicality inner zone and the trace's envelope. Not washes: strokes, the band's edge, the 70–85 % dots, the ghost dots, the dashed outer zone, any line. 1 in light themes, 3 in dark (Mark, 7 Nov 2026: the 12/16/24 % Needle wedges could not be told apart in dark themes); a theme or mode block may set its own. Print never reads it: on paper the fills take variabilityPrintAlphaScale instead.

tokens.name: variabilityWedgeCompositeMax
tokens.usage: On screen, the most the Needle's three stacked wedges (Icon and Cell) may composite to where all three overlap, as a share of the tone, so the full-tone needle still reads over the innermost (R25, Mark 7 Nov 2026: at variabilityWashAlpha 3 in dark themes it reached 91 %). The mark lowers the innermost wedge's alpha to fit; the outer two keep theirs. Light themes (44 %) and paper (60 %) never reach it. A theme or mode block may set its own.

behaviour.note: Not a look: numbers that decide WHEN a look changes (the grader in C++ applies the hysteresis; Theme mirrors it for QML). Not theme keys.

tokens.name: variabilityHysteresis
tokens.usage: Live-session grade hysteresis (variability spec §8.9): a grade changes only when ρ (or s′, or ρm) crosses a band edge by this much. The C++ grader applies it (hysteresisGrade); no component reads it, and a mark draws whatever grade it is given. Equals kHysteresis in src/Metrics/variability/variability_constants.h (the generator checks); frozen session assessments use the plain bands.
